description: We are a passionate and innovative team of aspiring engineers who believe in transforming ideas into impactful solutions. Our team brings together creativity, technical skills, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities to tackle real-world challenges through technology and innovation.
summary: We developed an interactive space exploration game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, based on India's important satellite missions. The game allows players to explore different planets and unlock new levels by completing challenges inspired by India's achievements in space technology. It addresses the challenge of making learning about space science and satellite missions more interesting and interactive rather than relying only on textbooks. This project is important because it creates awareness about ISRO and India's contributions to space exploration while encouraging curiosity, logical thinking, and problem-solving skills. It combines education and entertainment to make learning fun and engaging.
details:
How It Works

Players begin their mission by answering questions focused on satellites launched by India (ISRO)—covering their objectives, technologies, and scientific achievements. Each correct answer powers the spacecraft to advance to the next level, traveling to a new planet in our solar system. Upon arriving at each new world, players unlock a fresh stage with questions centered on that specific planet’s characteristics, environment, and exploration history.

Benefits & Intended Impact

Traditional space education can feel static and overwhelming. By turning satellite knowledge and planetary science into a progressive, level-unlocking adventure, the game promotes active recall and sustained curiosity. Built as a lightweight web application, it requires no installation or high-end hardware—making STEM learning accessible to students and space enthusiasts on any device with a browser. Our goal is to inspire interest in aerospace and astronomy while highlighting how India's satellite milestones contribute to humanity's broader understanding of the solar system.

Tools, Languages & Software Used

Bullet Languages: HTML5 (along with CSS for styling and JavaScript for interactive level logic, if applicable)

Bullet Software & Deployment: Web browsers, source code editor, and cloud web deployment tools for hosting the live application

Bullet Hardware: Standard team laptops/PCs for development and cross-device browser testing

Creativity & Team Considerations

Rather than presenting a conventional trivia list, we designed the game as a cosmic voyage where mastering real-world satellite achievements serves as the gateway to exploring new planets. While building the app, our team prioritized accessibility (keeping the HTML build fast and lightweight for low-bandwidth connections), educational pacing (structuring levels so difficulty scales naturally from satellite basics to planetary science), and intuitive UI/UX so players of all ages can jump straight into playing.
